newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Gilts must hold 113-24 for upside chances.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Gilts must hold 113-24 for upside chances.

text.p: September gilt futures on LIFFE face support at 113-31 and 113-24 which will be crucial to maintain the positive momentum on Tuesday, analysts said.
If gilts fail to hold above the July 11 and July 3 lows respectively they will be vulnerable to a test of trendline support coming at 113-09, Ian Stannard of Chase in London said.
"If we can hold above there it looks like gilts could recover with initial resistance at 114-14," said Stannard.
Gilts pulled back on Monday from near the top end of the current range to finish at 114-06. By 0705 GMT, September stood 4/32 down on the day at 114-02.
Stannard said a move above 114-14, the high on July 10, would stabilise the outlook for gilts from a corrective mood and allow a recovery to 114-30, the high on Monday.
Current falls would be considered as consolidation if the September contract managed to stay above 113-31, he said.
"Then we would have held above the old corrective low," said Stannard.
He added that a move above 114-14 would clear initial resistance, and lift gilts to a challenge of peaks above 115-00 that formed over the last weeks with the top on July 2 at 115-05.
Lynn Branigan, technical analyst at MCM YieldWatch said gilts needed to get back above 114-20 to reinstate gains. That level was the intraday high on Monday from where the contract turned lower.
"A break above 114-20 will trigger further gains to yesterday's high and the contract high at 115-05," he said.
But he added that holding above 113-31 was key. That level was also a 50 percent retracement of the gains from the 112-25 low on June 24 to the contract high.
At the short-end, December short sterling was unchanged on the day at 92.61.
